```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse) # for {dplyr} functions
library(rio) # for importing data
library(here) # for easy file referencing
library(sf) # for shapefiles
library(lubridate) # to work with dates
```

# Raw Data
import data:
```{r}
## cases
suspected <- here::here("data", "TIRS_SINAVE_combined22_23_blockID.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
```

# Cleaning
```{r}
# Cases only (no negative diagnoses)
cases <- suspected %>% 
  filter(Diagnosis != "Negativo") %>% 
  filter(Comentario != "Negativo")

# missing data?
sum(is.na(cases$MZTIRS))
which(is.na(cases$MZTIRS))
cases[63,]

cases <- cases %>% 
  mutate(block_id = ifelse(is.na(MZTIRS), str_sub(ID, 3, 4), MZTIRS))
```

Format to match c.positives.alpha.txt
```{r}
positives <- cases %>% 
  # IDperson, IDblock, IDcluster, date_symptoms, TIRS_arm, coordinates
  select(ID, block_id, CLUSTER, Week_onset, Arm_1TIRS, lon, lat) %>% 
  rename(person_id = ID,
         cluster_id = CLUSTER,
         week_sympt_onset = Week_onset,
         trial_arm = Arm_1TIRS)

```

global.mcmc.txt
```{r}
#Nindiv, Nnegs, Nclusters, NDAYS, DAY0, DAYL, SUSCEPTIBILITY_XI1, XI2, W
#TRANSMISSIBILITY_RHO, MAX_GENTIME, sigma_alpha, beta, gamma, Gta, Gtb
global.mcmc.txt <- c(
  as.numeric(nrow(positives)), #Nindiv
  0                            #Nnegs -- don't need in final model 
)
```
